The Northside / Our story

Built on the Northside.
Worn everywhere.

The Northside is more than a name on a piece of clothing. It is a reminder of where you started, who you came up with, and the energy you carry wherever you go.

01

Where it started

What started as a small run of hoodies became a visual language for people who wanted to represent their side of the city with confidence. The goal was simple: make pieces that feel authentic, wearable and unmistakably Northside.

02

Made for everyday life

Heavyweight hoodies, graphic tees, jackets and accessories are designed to move from the neighborhood to wherever the day takes you. Clean silhouettes keep the pieces easy to wear while the Northside identity stays loud.

03

Limited by design

Every drop is intentionally focused. Instead of filling a closet with noise, Northside pieces are made to become the ones you reach for again and again.

04

Carry where you're from

Your neighborhood is part of your story. Wear the name, build your own chapter and let the clothes speak for the places and people that shaped you.

“
